subject: literacy
concept: Making a simple prediction about what happens next in a story, based on clues so far
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student is paused mid-story and guesses what happens next based on clues so far, then finds out
exercise.pictorial: Student picks the most likely next-picture from several options based on story clues
exercise.abstract: Student writes or states a prediction with a reason based on evidence from the text

assessment.mastery_threshold: 4/5 correct (prediction reasoning tied to real text clues, not just guessing)
misconception_flags: makes a prediction unconnected to any clue in the passage

interest_binding: story content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
